# Flo Creative Consultancy

> Award-winning exhibition design & build and interior design, shaped around your brand from concept to handover. Based in Dubai, delivering across the GCC and overseas.

Flo Creative is a Dubai-based studio (Al Meydan, Dubai, UAE) working in two disciplines: Exhibition Design & Build, and Interior Design (retail, F&B, pop-ups, showrooms). Projects are shaped around the client's brand from concept to handover. Twenty years of GCC experience; award-winning designs. Build and installation are delivered through production partners, and in KSA through a sister company.

## Exhibition Design & Build
Concept & design, 3D renders, Technical drawings, Project management, Build & installation
- EOE (Eurospine 2026 · Sweden): A hospitality centre shaped by EOE’s identity. At its heart, a luminous Tree of Life inspired by the EOE logo, surrounded by an organic space where every partner felt welcome and no one missed a demo. Designed in Dubai, delivered overseas.
- PL Solutions (Riyadh, KSA · February 2026): A compact stand that gives PL Solutions a strong presence while keeping partner brands equally visible. Multiple access points let visitors test the products hands-on without crowding.

## Interior Design
Retail, F&B, Pop-ups, Fit-out & space planning, FF&E, Specifications & drawings, Renders
- Bassmat Rashid Bin Saeed (Al Jalila Foundation, Dubai): A fully automated robotic donor wall that engraves donor names in real time. Inaugurated by H.H. Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum.
- Happiness World (Panda Hypermarket, Jeddah): Continuous coloured lines, neon signage, candy-shaped ceiling elements and floor graphics turn a hypermarket aisle into a destination for young shoppers.
- The Hide (Jeddah, KSA): Natural wood, soft greenery and ambient lighting for a relaxed, quietly chic café that works from day to night.
- Skinovation (Dubai, UAE): A high-energy, unapologetically feminine store built on bold colour and customer-first spatial planning.

## Request a proposal
Share the event name, dates and stand size (or interior type and floor area), city and sector at https://flocreative.ae/#proposal.
